repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Campaign160 inventory and Campaign163-201 source-frontier metadata only
repository_evidence.human_capital_boundary: Campaign164 covers the issuer's employees, workforce composition, training and retention. A student's application, enrollment, course progression and graduation are customer-service delivery states, not employee human-capital states.
repository_evidence.milestone_license_boundary: Campaign167 and Campaign179 govern school openings, approvals, accreditation, certification and operating licenses as discrete milestones or rights. A single opening, accreditation or certificate does not preserve the recurring student cohort, course delivery, progression, withdrawal and tuition lifecycle.
repository_evidence.operating_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 freezes customer or user counts, site footprint, utilization and service volume. Aggregate applications, enrollments, active learners, course seats, campuses or graduates do not preserve student-level or privacy-safe cohort transitions, failed applications, deferrals, withdrawals, repeats and completion denominators.
repository_evidence.customer_quality_and_support_boundary: Campaign170 freezes satisfaction, complaints, retention and refund outcomes, while Campaign199 freezes support-ticket stock flow and SLA clocks. Survey scores or a learner-support ticket cannot substitute for application, enrollment, attendance, assessment, progression and completion identities.
repository_evidence.pricing_payment_and_accounting_boundary: Campaign169 freezes tuition prices, discounts and contract terms, while Campaign195 freezes authorization, clearing, settlement, dispute and reserve rails. Tuition revenue, receivables, deferred revenue, refunds, bad debt or payment transactions do not establish eligibility, scholarship award, enrollment, learning access, course delivery, withdrawal and collection state.
repository_evidence.privacy_and_lawful_use_boundary: No directly identifiable student record, protected education record, confidential transcript, assessment response, disability or demographic record, financial-aid application or unlawfully obtained learner data may be acquired or used. Any admitted source must be lawful, licensed or public, deidentified and aggregate enough to avoid re-identification while preserving the frozen point-in-time issuer-state contract.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Applicable listed education, vocational-training, tutoring, higher-education, language, professional-certification and learning-service issuers must be frozen point in time. Corporate internal training departments, software vendors and structurally inapplicable issuers may not be filled with zero or cross-sector ranked.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current campus, student roster, transcript, course catalog, graduation list or receivable status cannot be projected backward without complete application, offer, acceptance, enrollment, registration, attendance, assessment, progression, withdrawal, completion, tuition, aid, refund, collection, correction and first-public or first-licensed-availability histories.
